description.description: A set of frames from a video showing an individual engaging with an electrical utility box at night. In the first frame, a person is seen from the back, leaning into an open, damaged utility box with a backpack lying on the ground. In the second frame, the view is from a different angle, showing the internal components like meters and wiring inside the box. In the third frame, a light from the person's phone or a flashlight illuminates the box, which has signs on it for 'NATIONWIDE DEBT COLLECTORS' and 'QUICK CASH LOAN'.
